source_description: Replaces Felix's general-purpose Sonnet heartbeat with a two-layer observation pipeline. felix-core-digest gains deterministic signal extraction + threshold-driven issue filing. A Haiku gate fronts the OpenClaw heartbeat and only escalates to Sonnet on novel/ambiguous signal. Prompted by GitHub issue #490, where the current heartbeat mis-stated the scope of a WhatsApp creds.json corruption incident (reported 'two episodes', actual scope 151 events over 16+ hours).
